## NFL injury briefing

### Falcons
- **Cameron Williams (OT)** was placed on **reserve/injured**, so he’s **out for Sunday’s Week 1 game vs. the Steelers**.
- Atlanta also elevated **Nick Muse (TE)** and **Bralen Trice (EDGE)** from the practice squad.
- The big unresolved issue is **Cooper Rush**. He’s the **latest starting quarterback**, and the update says his health is the main concern, but his final status is **not specified** in the provided data.

**Why it matters:** Atlanta’s QB situation is still the most important storyline. Losing Williams also affects depth up front.

### Chiefs
- **Patrick Mahomes** is **returning Monday night** after a **December 2025 torn ACL**.
- **Josh Simmons (LT)** is **out** with a **back injury**.
- **Chamarri Conner (DB)** is also **out** with a **knee injury**.
- **Kahlil Benson** will start at **left tackle** in his **first career game**.
- No other Chiefs players have an injury designation.

**Why it matters:** Mahomes is back, but Kansas City’s protection is in flux with Simmons out. Conner’s absence also affects the secondary.

### What to watch next
- **Cooper Rush’s final status** for Atlanta.
- **How Kahlil Benson holds up** in his first start at left tackle.
- **Mahomes’ return** and whether the Chiefs’ line can protect him cleanly.
